newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-W.P. ASKED TO BAT BY NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-W.P. ASKED TO BAT BY NATAL.

text.p: Natal won the toss and asked Western Province to bat in their four day Supersport Series match at Newlands on Friday.
Western Province - Desmond Haynes, Gary Kirsten, Jacques Kallis, Herschelle Gibbs, John Commins (captain), HD Ackerman, Brian McMillan, Paul Kirsten, Craig Matthews, Brett Schultz, Owen McHelm.
Natal - Andrew Hudson, Dougie Watson, Errol Stewart, Jonty Rhodes, Dale Benkenstein (captain), Derek Crookes, Neil Johnson, Keith Forde, Pat Symcox, Gary Gilder, Keith Storey.
